# k0rdent_share_type (Data Source)

One storage capability class, by id.

Reading the class a store names is the plan-time way to find out that it does not exist in this region. Supplying one that does not is otherwise a `422` partway through the apply.

Use `k0rdent_share_types` when the id is not known ahead of time, or to pick by capability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reading the share type fails the plan if it doesn't exist in this region,
# instead of failing the apply.
data "k0rdent_share_type" "fast" {
  id = "high-speed"
}

resource "k0rdent_file_store" "datasets" {
  share_type   = data.k0rdent_share_type.fast.id
  capacity_gib = 4096
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The class id, for example `general` or `high-speed`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Optional

- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `capabilities` (Map of String) Capability facts about the class as flat key/value pairs, for example `protocol = "nfs"` or `tier = "performance"`.

The set of keys is not fixed, so read the ones you know and ignore the rest. Values are drawn from a capability vocabulary only: the backing hardware cannot be inferred from this map and must not be guessed at.
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly name, suitable for a picker.
- `max_capacity_gib` (Number) The largest `capacity_gib` one store can be given from this class. Null when the class sets no ceiling of its own.
- `self_link` (String) Platform-defined reference to this class.
- `state` (String) The class's lifecycle state. Only an `active` class can be provisioned from.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_share_types`](../data-sources/share_types.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_file_store`](../resources/file_store.md) resource: takes a class's id in `share_type`.
